_README: PLACEHOLDER TESTIMONIALS. Every entry below is invented sample copy so the layout can be reviewed. Replace each one with a real quote (with the person's permission) and set "placeholder": false. Entries with placeholder: true show a visible 'Contoh / Sample' tag on the site.

quote.id: Dulu Kevin diam saja kalau ditanya pakai bahasa Inggris. Sekarang dia yang ngajarin adiknya nyanyi lagu-lagu dari kelas.
quote.en: Kevin used to go quiet whenever someone asked him something in English. Now he's the one teaching his little sister the songs from class.

quote.id: Saya ikut Pre-TOEFL dua bulan sebelum daftar beasiswa. Yang paling membantu: latihan per bagian dan cara ngatur waktunya.
quote.en: I joined Pre-TOEFL two months before applying for a scholarship. What helped most was practising section by section, and learning how to pace myself.

quote.id: Kelasnya habis jam kerja, jadi masih kekejar. Sekarang saya nggak deg-degan lagi kalau rapat sama klien dari luar.
quote.en: Classes start after office hours, so I can actually make it. These days I don't panic when we have calls with overseas clients.

quote.id: Hari pertama anak saya nangis di depan pintu. Bulan ketiga, dia yang narik tangan saya supaya cepat berangkat.
quote.en: On day one my son cried at the door. By the third month he was the one pulling my hand so we'd leave on time.

quote.id: Grammar-nya dijelasin pakai contoh dari obrolan kita sendiri di kelas. Jadi nggak ngantuk, dan lebih nempel.
quote.en: Grammar gets explained with examples from our own conversations in class. So it's not boring, and it actually sticks.
